newsitem.title: UK: LLoyd Thompson to pay special dividend.
newsitem.headline: LLoyd Thompson to pay special dividend.

text.p: Lloyd Thompson Group Plc said it intended to pay a special dividend of 6.0 pence net per Lloyd Thompson share, subject to its merger with JIB Group Plc proceeding.
The company said the special dividend would return capital to Lloyd Thompson shareholders and replace the share buy-back approved at the Lloyd Thompson annual general meeting held in October.

If the merger proceeds, Lloyd Thompson will not acquire shares under the authority given at that meeting. Lloyd Thompson said it intended to pay an interim dividend of 6.25 pence per Lloyd Thompson share in respect of the six months to December 31, 1996.
